decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2128pag##.dgn, dated 12.08.14; Parcel Locker Signage, dated 12.08.14; ParcelLocker3.83with.dgn, dated 16.07.14; Design and Access Statement 2128/150714TL/DAS, dated July 2014 - received 19/08/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The barrier installed at the entrance to the car park as a result of planning consent 01106/B/92 shall be retained for the lifetime of the development, unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and shall be closed from 2300 hours to 0500 hours on Monday to Sunday.
description: Installation of non-food locker system on the east side of the store
